description: Create an asynchronous Feed API order report task: feedType LMS_ORDER_REPORT, schemaVersion (1113 or higher) and optional filterCriteria (creationDateRange of at most 10 days, orderStatus ACTIVE or COMPLETED). eBay answers 202; returns taskId and Location. Poll ebay_get_order_task until COMPLETED or COMPLETED_WITH_ERROR, then download with ebay_get_feed_task_result_file. Requires sell.fulfillment.

filterCriteria.description: Order filters (modified-date filters are not supported by eBay yet)

creationDateRange.description: Order creation window of at most 10 days; eBay defaults to the last 10 days

orderStatus.description: OrderStatusEnum: ACTIVE or COMPLETED; both when omitted

schemaVersion.description: LMS OrderReport schema version: an odd number of at least 1113, shown on the OrderReport reference page

name: ebay_create_order_task
